records.actualTextDelta: The new DE/EN descriptions explicitly require performing and evaluating selected reducing-carbohydrate and glucose assays and explaining their differing analytical scope through molecular structure and enzyme action. The performance operator remains; no requirement to execute every example method is introduced.
records.fiveCasePackageScope: This goal contributes exactly its three retained whole cases, not the two 0b cases.

caseSpecificFit.finding: Benedict-positive/GOD-negative with valid controls is exactly the contrast made explicit in the new description. The expected answer correctly indicates reducing material without identifying glucose and retains detection-limit/interference boundaries. A negative GOD result is not made a proof of absolute absence.

Planning maltose/sucrose before/after hydrolysis connects accessible reducing forms and anomeric linkage to the assay result. Maltose can reduce before hydrolysis; sucrose requires cleavage for the expected positive carbohydrate products. Controls of acid treatment before alkaline testing remain required. This case is planning and explanation, not evidence of performed work.

The supervised glucose/fructose/water comparison provides an observable acquisition route for the retained perform operator: time, temperature, sample/reagent amounts, controls and own records are specified. The Cu(II)/Cu(I) reducing behaviour versus enzyme specificity now matches the wording more directly. No expected result is recast as real learner data.

records.wholeProfileFit: The existing structure-and-evidence, fresh-transfer and execution expectations all remain necessary and supported at design level. New wording states their existing analytic distinction; it does not add a disconnected fourth skill or waive the practical evidence needed for an individual mastery decision.
records.practicalAndQuantitativeBoundary: The previously actually read manufacturer method and its limits remain relevant: a 1 percent mass/volume sugar loading is10000mg/L and can exceed the GOD strip range. The existing case explicitly calls for dilution when scale is exceeded. Separate suitable GOD aliquots and the manufacturer timing/pH conditions remain required; hot alkaline Benedict mixtures do not become valid GOD samples. No laboratory execution has been observed here.
records.sourceAndMemoryBoundary: All source routes, case texts and own prerequisites are unchanged. The literal contribution/source-track boundaries of the prior review remain; no entire jurisdiction or course is approved. Existing memory_required and original card duty remain without a new M vote.
records.relationToV: The separate negative-caption REVISE concerns the existing optional orientation image. It does not invalidate these scientifically bounded case demands or silently repair that image.

wholeGoal.title: Individuelle Verdauungs- und Resorptionsunterschiede begründen
wholeGoal.titleEn: Justify individual differences in digestion and intestinal absorption
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann genetisch bedingte oder erworbene individuelle Unterschiede bei Verdauung und Resorption von Nahrungsbestandteilen chemisch begründen.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can chemically justify genetically caused or acquired individual differences in digestion and intestinal absorption of food components.

records.actualTextDelta: Only authored English title/description replace resorption with intestinal absorption. DE title/description, requirements and resources are byte-for-byte unchanged. This names the uptake process already used by both English case texts.

caseSpecificFit.finding: Lower lactase activity limits hydrolysis of lactose into glucose/galactose and therefore production of absorbable monosaccharides. The new English absorption wording does not collapse hydrolysis into transport.

The supplied second model forms a monosaccharide but has reduced intestinal-wall transport. Comparing that uptake limitation with lactase absence directly supports intestinal absorption as the intended English meaning.

records.wholeProfileFit: The retained chemical mechanism and fresh-transfer expectations remain supported. An explanatory answer must distinguish cleavage from uptake and locate the changed step; merely translating the word is not competence evidence.
records.causalAndAcquisitionBoundary: The model stipulates activity/transport differences and explains their downstream chemistry. It does not establish which genetic variant or acquired condition applies to any person, diagnose disease, supply patient observations or claim a real experiment. No upstream cause or learner performance is invented.
records.sourceAndMemoryBoundary: Previously read literal contribution boundaries remain unchanged; no broad country/track approval is made. Existing no_memory_needed remains without a new M decision.
